name: VBS4 (Virtual Battlespace 4)
description: Military virtual training platform for dismounted and mounted force-on-force exercises, developed by Bohemia Interactive Simulations. Used by 60+ militaries worldwide for individual and collective training at team through company level. Produces emergent small-unit tactical dynamics through realistic terrain, ballistics, and AI-driven opposing forces.
reputation: de facto standard virtual training platform for NATO and allied ground forces; used by U.S. Army, U.S. Marine Corps, UK, Australia, and 60+ other nations
notes: Successor to VBS3; built on Enfusion engine. Supports scripted and emergent scenario design. Widely used for urban operations, convoy, and CQB training. AAR (After Action Review) module built in.
